title: Tensor coherence of the normalized localized pullback square
statement: Fix schemes X,Y, f:X to Y, coefficient ring sheaves RY,RX and c:f-inverse RY isomorphic to RX. Let g be any Global datum, V any object of Y-pro-etale, and l any Local datum of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data]. Put F=g.operation.left, G=l.restrictionY.model.functor, H=l.restrictionX.model.functor, K=l.operation.left, and theta=l.pullback.inv:G K to F H. Let tF,tG,tH,tK be the homomorphisms of the global pullback tensor comparison, the Y restriction comparison, the X restriction comparison and the local pullback comparison. For every P,Q in Der(RY), theta(P tensor Q);H(tF(P,Q));tH(FP,FQ) equals K(tG(P,Q));tK(GP,GQ);(theta(P) tensor theta(Q)). This is only a pullback-tensor coherence equation; it neither constructs l nor asserts any equation for projection mates.

proof.text: The ordinary tensor-square theorem follows from the inverse-mate unit identity, the two pure_unit formulas, restriction pure_sections and pure-section extensionality. Apply it to each (p,q) summand of the signed total tensor: the summand inclusions for totalMap and naturality of gamma reduce the chain-square equality to the inverse ordinary square. This is proved in private total_square; the bidegrees do not change.

proof.text: Invert the four TensorComparison representative equations and paste them in pairs (private model_inverse and two_models). The private four_models_inverse calculation stays abstract in the four module functors to avoid unfolding concrete site constructions. Naturality of the target tensor representative, the just-proved chain square, and normalization at P,Q and total(P,Q) identify the two inverse tensor routes on resolving inputs; cancel their exact factor and tensor-model isomorphisms. Both inverse routes form natural transformations on pairs of derived objects. Faithfulness of restriction to resolving pairs extends equality to all inputs, and cancelling the composite tensor comparison isomorphisms gives the stated forward equation.

theorem localTensorSquare
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X)
    (g : Global f R_Y R_X c) (V : Y.ProEt)
    (l : Local f R_Y R_X c g V) :
    letI := l.restrictionYAdditive
    letI := l.restrictionXAdditive
    ∀ P Q : Der R_Y,
    l.pullback.inv.app (g.tensorY.functor.obj (P, Q)) ≫
        l.restrictionX.model.functor.map (g.tensorComparison.comparison.hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
        l.restrictionTensorX.comparison.hom.app
          (g.operation.left.obj P, g.operation.left.obj Q) =
      l.operation.left.map (l.restrictionTensorY.comparison.hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
        l.tensorComparison.comparison.hom.app
          (l.restrictionY.model.functor.obj P, l.restrictionY.model.functor.obj Q) ≫
        l.tensorX.functor.map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
          (l.pullback.inv.app P) (l.pullback.inv.app Q))
